dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Hmph. It's high time we took care of these crooks...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: When that storm from before had just appeared, the Knights and the Adventurers' Guild sprang into action.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: But as we were busy with evacuation and rescue work, it seems as though some Treasure Hoarders managed to sneak in amid the chaos.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: These thieves took advantage of that moment when we were stretched thin, and managed to steal quite a few things throughout the city.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Carrots from the Dawn Winery, Philanemo Mushrooms from Springvale, a stack of silverware from the Goth Grand Hotel... Hmph, they've even stolen some of the food stocked in the Good Hunter's larder.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: If it's not nailed down, these bandits will take it. Why, if this storm hadn't subsided so quickly, I doubt there'd be anything left in Mondstadt to steal.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: We've got enough hands on deck again, but looking for those things may prove very difficult. The speed at which they flee with their loot is only surpassed by their ability to fence it.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Still, we must make them pay.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Honorary Knight. If you're willing, would you like to have a little chat with those Treasure Hoarders?
